q01:
WITH region_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.name AS region,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN
        regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE
        o.status ='shipped'
        AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    GROUP BY
        r.name
    HAVING
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) > 0
)
SELECT
    region,
    SUM(revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    region_revenue
GROUP BY
    region
ORDER BY
    revenue_cents DESC
q02:
WITH orders_q2 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
        AND o.status ='shipped'
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
), order_lines_q2 AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS total_order_amount
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN orders_q2 oq ON ol.order_id = oq.order_id
    GROUP BY ol.order_id
), refunds_q2 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS total_refund_amount
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE r.refunded_at BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
), net_revenue_q2 AS (
    SELECT ool.order_id, ool.total_order_amount - COALESCE(rr.total_refund_amount, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
    FROM order_lines_q2 ool
    LEFT JOIN refunds_q2 rr ON ool.order_id = rr.order_id
)
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue_q2

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS order_total_cents
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE
        o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2027-01-31'
        AND o.status ='shipped'
    GROUP BY
        o.order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_total_cents
    FROM
        refunds r
    WHERE
        r.refunded_at BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2027-01-31'
    GROUP BY
        r.order_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(orev.order_total_cents - IFNULL(rrev.refund_total_cents, 0)) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    order_revenue orev
LEFT JOIN
    refund_totals rrev ON orev.order_id = rrev.order_id
q05:
WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(ol.qty * ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM
        order_lines ol
    JOIN
        orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
        AND o.status ='shipped'
),
refunds_total AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM
        refunds r
    JOIN
        orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        r.refunded_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
    r.category,
    COALESCE(revenue.revenue_cents, 0) - COALESCE(refunds.refund_cents, 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products) p
LEFT JOIN
    revenue ON p.category = revenue.category
LEFT JOIN
    refunds_total refunds ON p.category = refunds.category
GROUP BY
    r.category
ORDER BY
    revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1
q06:
WITH services_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty,
        ol.amount_cents
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN
        products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE
        p.category ='services'
        AND o.status ='shipped'
        AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
), services_refunds AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents
    FROM
        refunds r
    WHERE
        r.refund_id IN (
            SELECT
                r.refund_id
            FROM
                refunds r
            JOIN
                orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
            WHERE
                o.status ='shipped'
                AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
        )
    GROUP BY
        r.order_id
), net_services_orders AS (
    SELECT
        so.order_id,
        so.customer_id,
        so.product_id,
        so.qty,
        so.amount_cents - COALESCE(sr.refunded_cents, 0) AS net_amount_cents
    FROM
        services_orders so
    LEFT JOIN
        services_refunds sr ON so.order_id = sr.order_id
)
SELECT
    r.name AS region,
    SUM(nso.net_amount_cents) AS services_revenue_cents
FROM
    net_services_orders nso
JOIN
    customers c ON nso.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN
    regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY
    r.name

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        SUM(ol.qty * ol.amount_cents) AS total_cents
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE
        o.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND o.status ='shipped'
        AND o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'

        o.order_id
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM
        refunds r
    JOIN
        orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE
        o.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY
        r.order_id
),
net_revenues AS (
    SELECT
        ot.order_id,
        ot.total_cents - COALESCE(rt.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
    FROM
        order_totals ot
    LEFT JOIN
        refund_totals rt ON ot.order_id = rt.order_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(net_revenue_cents) AS avg_revenue_cents
FROM
    net_revenues

WITH
  -- Get all orders placed in September 2026
  september_orders AS (
    SELECT
      order_id
    FROM
      orders
    WHERE
      strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2026-09'
      AND status ='shipped'
  ),
  -- Get all order lines for the orders placed in September 2026
  september_order_lines AS (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      SUM(amount_cents) AS total_order_amount_cents
    FROM
      order_lines
    WHERE
      order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM september_orders)
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ),
  -- Get all refunds for the orders placed in September 2026
  september_refunds AS (
    SELECT
      order_id,
      SUM(amount_cents) AS total_refund_amount_cents
    FROM
      refunds
    WHERE
      order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM september_orders)
    GROUP BY
      order_id
  ),
  -- Calculate net revenue for each order
  net_revenue AS (
    SELECT
      so.order_id,
      so.total_order_amount_cents - COALESCE(sr.total_refund_amount_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
    FROM
      september_order_lines so
      LEFT JOIN september_refunds sr ON so.order_id = sr.order_id
  )
SELECT
  SUM(net_revenue_cents) AS september_revenue_cents
FROM
  net_revenue
